name: multi-mcp-gateway
description: 統一 MCP 閘道器 — 單一插槽代理多個下游 MCP 伺服器

scripts.build:extension: npm run build && npm install --prefix extensions/vscode-multi-mcp-manager && npm run compile --prefix extensions/vscode-multi-mcp-manager
scripts.package:extension: npm run build:extension && npm run package --prefix extensions/vscode-multi-mcp-manager
scripts.preflight:extension: npm run build:extension && npm run test --prefix extensions/vscode-multi-mcp-manager
scripts.preflight:gateway: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:runtime
